services.name: Western Wednesdays & Saturdays - 4 Hours
services.desc: Enjoy an afternoon exploring the mountains, and finish your day off with a delicious cowboy cookout at Tanque Verde Ranch. We will deliver your vehicles to the ranch and make the reservations for your group's dinner. After your ride simply head back down the mountain to the ranch. The ranch staff will help direct you to the cookout and collect your vehicle's keys. Tanque Verde Ranch is just a mile south of the trails. Start closer. Stay out longer. Enjoy a 5-star BBQ dinner! Dinner $49.99 per person, and is not included with your rental. 4 Hours | Dinner begins at 7:00pm during the 4 Hour Ride & Dine

services.name: Mountain Wilderness Adventure - 6hour
services.desc: Please plan on arriving 20-30 minutes prior to your rides start time. 6 Hours Description The 6 hour booking allows you to explore deeper into Redington Pass, and is a personal favorite of ours. Instead of having to turn back when things start to get interesting on a 4 hour ride, the extra two hours allow you access to two additional trails. The first trail is called Scenic Loop. What the loop lacks in technical difficulty it makes up for with breathtaking views. The second trail is a much larger loop and is perfect for those looking for a route with lots of climbing, descending, and 6 Hours - Our Favorite Trail

blurb: Guests rent Polaris RZR off-road vehicles or Polaris Slingshots to explore trails in Southern Arizona including Mount Lemmon, Redington Pass, and the Sonoran Desert. Vehicles come with GPS navigation and a full tank of gas; renters must refill with 91 octane gasoline. Guided and self-guided options are available, including night rides and full moon packages.
